author: alec hepburn
content:
I BOOKED THE PINK PACKAGE, LOADS OF THICK FLOOR MATS LOADS OF SOFT PLAY TOYS, SEE SAWS, CLIMBING BLOCKS, TUNNELS, AND VARIOUS SOFT BLOCKS.
I ALSO HAD THE BIG BOX OF MEGA BLOCKS TO BUILD WITH AND THE BIG BOX BALL PIT WITH THE SLIDE.
THE DELIVERY TEAM TURNED BANG ON TIME DESPITE THE UNFORESEEN DIVERSION OUTSIDE THE VENUE WHICH DELAYED MY GUESTS.
THE SET UP WAS QUICK AND FRIENDLY WITH AN EXPLANATION OF HOW TO LOOK AFTER THE EQUIPMENT.
THE KIDS WERE AGED FROM 18 MONTHS UP TO 7 YEARS OLD AND EVERY ONE OF THEM LOVED IT, THEY RAN THEMSELVES RAGGED PLAYING WITH EVERYTHING AND GENERALLY ROUND IN CIRCLES ON THE MATS.
IT WAS THE BEST KIDS PARTY I HAVE EVER BEEN TO (AND I'VE BEEN TO A FEW) AND THERE WERE NO TV'S, NO PLAYSTATIONS OR X-BOX'S JUST GOOD OLD FASHIONED FUN,
I WILL DEFINITELY BE USING DANCING CUBS AGAIN, AND WOULD STRONGLY RECOMMEND THEM.
